legacy_root.question: What is the per-vendor adapter maintenance cost? Enumerate the vendor-specific surfaces (prompt transport, tool and permission model, output schema, progress/streaming, timeout, session state, model naming) and estimate each surface's change frequency from OBSERVED vendor release cadence over a stated window - then state which surfaces must be versioned to avoid breaking on a vendor update.

window.reason: Codex GitHub pagination returned 400 newest releases whose oldest published_at is 2026-03-13. Using a longer window would undercount Codex CLI cadence. API notes exist earlier; those earlier dates are cited only when marked in_observation_window=false.

remeasure.policy: Re-measure once with a mechanically different probe (different field). If the two readings disagree, report BLOCKED with both numbers rather than picking one.

claude_code_github_releases.note: These two GitHub timestamp fields disagree by one release (138 vs 137). Per retry policy this cadence is NOT picked; both numbers are reported. It is not a headline.

surfaces.why_version: SDK HTTP client class and regional request host are load-bearing adapter fields. A pinned transport version keeps httpx vs httpx2 and un-prefixed vs prefixed hosts from silently swapping.

Mid-conversation tool changes beta (mid-conversation-tool-changes-2026-07-01) on Fable 5, Mythos 5, Opus 4.8, and Opus 5.
SDKs added code_execution_20260120 (REPL state persistence); set tools[].type to that id, no beta header.

Pin the schema wire format so a second rename cannot land un-gated. In-window Anthropic notes did not repeat that rename; the 2026-01-29 GA is cited as outside-window evidence, not counted in the in-window rate.

error_band.note: Curated counts are ±1 event. Keyword hits over-count model launch notes that mention tools/streaming incidentally and are not used as the rate.

Structured outputs left beta; output_format moved to output_config.format. Existing beta header still accepted during transition.

surfaces.why_version: SSE event names and delta envelopes changed (event_deltas on session/thread streams; thinking.display). A progress parser that treats every event as a result will mis-fire after an envelope rename.

error_band.note: Curated counts are ±1 event. Keyword hits over-count model launch notes that mention tools/streaming incidentally and are not used as the rate.

thinking.display field launched so thinking content can be omitted from responses (streaming payload shape).

surfaces.why_version: Numeric budgets moved: 90-second code-execution cell limit, SDK Timeout objects sourced from httpx2, and OpenAI hard spend caps that return 429. Pin timeout constants per adapter version.

error_band.note: Curated counts are ±1 event. Keyword hits over-count model launch notes that mention tools/streaming incidentally and are not used as the rate.

surfaces.why_version: Session control fields were removed or renamed (compaction_control dropped from the Python tool runner; agent-memory-2026-07-22 changes memory listing). Unversioned session adapters will call missing params.

Managed-agent session budgets: a hard spend cap pauses the session with stop reason budget_reached.

surfaces.why_version: Model ids launched and retired inside the window (Opus 5, Sonnet 5, Fable 5, GPT-5.6 family; Opus 4.1 / Sonnet 4 / Opus 4 / Haiku 3 retirements). Dispatch tables that hard-code a moving alias fail closed only if the id is versioned.

citations.snippet: Claude Opus 4.1 (claude-opus-4-1-20250805) retired; requests now return an error. Recommend Claude Opus 5.
Claude Opus 5 (claude-opus-5) launched; disabling thinking at effort xhigh/max returns 400 (breaking vs Opus 4.8).
Claude Sonnet 5 (claude-sonnet-5) launched; manual extended thinking and non-default sampling return 400.
Claude Sonnet 4 (claude-sonnet-4-20250514) and Claude Opus 4 (claude-opus-4-20250514) retired; requests return errors.
Claude Fable 5 (claude-fable-5) launched alongside Claude Mythos 5 (claude-mythos-5); adaptive thinking is the only thinking mode.
Claude Haiku 3 (claude-3-haiku-20240307) retired; requests now return an error. Recommend Claude Haiku 4.5.
GPT-5.6 family released (gpt-5.6-sol / terra / luna); gpt-5.6 alias routes to gpt-5.6-sol.
GPT-5.5 released on Chat Completions, Responses, and Batch.

forecast.falsifiable_statement: Between 2026-08-24 and 2026-11-22 inclusive, Anthropic API release notes or the OpenAI API changelog will publish at least one new GA model id (claude-* or gpt-*) OR retire/error an existing GA model id. If neither source records such an event in that window, this forecast is FALSE.
forecast.basis: In the 165-day observation window the frozen notes record multiple GA launches (Opus 5, Sonnet 5, Fable 5, GPT-5.6, GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4 mini/nano) and multiple retirements (Opus 4.1, Sonnet 4, Opus 4, Haiku 3). That is more than one naming event per month. The 90-day forecast is the same cadence, not a new mechanism.

inputs_absent.note: ARC-0038 artifact is absent on this worktree; cost uses vendor notes, not the A6 dossier.

legacy_root.answer: Over 2026-03-13..2026-08-24 (165 days, notes retrieved 2026-08-24) the frozen Anthropic API notes carry 54 dated headings and the OpenAI changelog 42 dated entries. All seven catalog surfaces must be versioned: model_naming is the hottest (multiple GA launches and retirements), then tool_permission_model (computer_toolset_20260801 and permission_policy), then session_state and progress_streaming (removed compaction_control; event_deltas). output_schema had only one in-window OpenAI mention; the Anthropic output_format->output_config.format rename is 2026-01-29 (outside window) and is still a version pin. Timeout has the fewest notes (90s cell limit, httpx2 Timeout, 429 spend caps) but the constants still need a pin. Claude Code GitHub cadence is reported as published_at=138 vs created_at=137 and is not picked. Forecast: model_naming will see another GA id or retirement by 2026-11-22 (confidence 0.65-0.90).
